story.so_that: workflow artifacts are grouped by source document, the race between post-edit verification and SkillActivity is eliminated, and a missing sentinel after a successful harness run can be treated as a real failure again
story.as_a: Skill and Workflow Engineer maintaining the agentic software factory
story.i_want: skill sentinel files to remain on disk after verification and be written to a `.process` directory under the same parent as the skill's first input document, falling back to the repository root `.process` directory only when no input path is supplied

journey.before: Sam observes that SkillActivity sometimes falls back to an expected output path and emits a warning because the post-edit verification hook consumes the sentinel before the Activity can read it, and the repository root `.process` directory is cluttered with sentinel files from every skill run
journey.during: Sam updates the skill instructions, verification scripts, SkillActivity sentinel derivation, tests, and the post-edit hook so that sentinels are written next to their source document and are never deleted after verification
journey.after: Sam can trust a missing sentinel as a real failure, review co-located workflow artifacts grouped by source document, and remove the warning fallback path from SkillActivity once the new contract is adopted

capability_breakdown.core_action: Change the skill sentinel contract so that every skill writes its `{skill-name}.done.json` sentinel into a `.process` directory co-located with the first input document, leaves the sentinel on disk after verification, and derives the sentinel path from the input path in SkillActivity and the fake harness
outputs: co-located `{skill-name}.done.json` sentinel file next to the first input document
updated skill SKILL.md files with the co-located sentinel instruction
updated `verify.sh` scripts that no longer delete sentinels
updated `skill_activity.py` deriving the sentinel path from `input_paths[0]` with repo-root fallback
updated `tests/fake_harness.py` writing the sentinel next to the first input
updated unit tests asserting co-located sentinel paths
updated post-edit hook comments and path assumptions
state_changes: sentinel files persist on disk after successful verification
sentinel files move from repo root `.process/` to `<first_input_parent>/.process/`
`verify.sh` scripts remove `rm -f "$sentinel_path"` or equivalent delete logic
`SkillActivity.execute` and `run_skill` derive the default sentinel path from the first input path
`SkillActivity.execute` only deletes a stale sentinel before invocation, not after
workflow artifacts are grouped by source document

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every skill SKILL.md instructs the agent to write the sentinel into a `.process` folder under the same parent as the input document and not to delete it after verification
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a skill's SKILL.md When the instructions are read Then they state that the `{skill-name}.done.json` sentinel must be created in `<input_parent>/.process/` and must not be removed after verification
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Document the co-located, persistent sentinel contract

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every `verify.sh` reads the sentinel, validates the artifact, and leaves the sentinel in place
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a `verify.sh` script for any skill When the script is inspected Then it does not contain `rm -f "$sentinel_path"` or any equivalent sentinel-deletion logic
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Keep sentinels on disk after verification

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `SkillActivity.execute` derives the default sentinel path from the first input path and falls back to the repo root only when `input_paths` is empty
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a SkillActivity invocation with one or more input paths When the harness completes and writes a sentinel Then `SkillActivity` looks for it at `Path(input_paths[0]).parent / '.process' / f'{skill_name}.done.json'`, and only uses `repo_root / '.process'` when `input_paths` is empty
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Locate sentinels next to their source document

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `SkillActivity.execute` deletes only a stale sentinel before invocation, not after
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a previous run left a sentinel in the co-located `.process` directory When `SkillActivity.execute` starts Then it removes the stale sentinel before invoking the harness and does not delete any sentinel after the harness returns

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `SkillActivity.execute` prompt instructs the agent to write the sentinel into the co-located `.process` directory
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given `SkillActivity.build_prompt` is called with input paths When the prompt is built Then it includes an instruction to create the sentinel in the `.process` directory under the first input's parent
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Guide agents to write co-located sentinels

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `run_skill` helper applies the same co-located sentinel fallback logic
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given `run_skill` is called with input paths When the harness completes Then the sentinel is expected at `Path(input_paths[0]).parent / '.process' / f'{skill_name}.done.json'`, falling back to `repo_root / '.process'` when no input paths are supplied
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Apply co-located sentinel logic to standalone skill helper

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `tests/fake_harness.py` writes the sentinel next to the first input
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the fake harness runs a skill with an input path When it writes the sentinel Then the sentinel is created in `<first_input_parent>/.process/<skill-name>.done.json` instead of the repository root `.process`

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unit tests that assert root `.process` sentinel paths are updated to co-located paths or use empty `input_paths` to trigger the fallback
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the existing `test_skill_activity.py` suite When the tests are updated Then assertions that previously expected `repo_root / '.process' / 'custom.done.json'` are changed to the co-located path, or the test input is empty to exercise the fallback
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Verify co-located sentinel behavior with unit tests

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `.devin/scripts/post-edit-verify-skill.sh` comments and path assumptions are updated to clarify that sentinels are co-located and not consumed
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the post-edit hook script When it is inspected Then its comments describe co-located, persistent sentinels and its glob or path assumptions match `*/.process/*.done.json` without implying the root `.process` is the only location
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Align post-edit hook with co-located sentinels

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A missing sentinel after a successful harness run is treated as a real failure instead of a warning fallback
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the harness exits successfully but no sentinel is found in the expected co-located path When `SkillActivity.execute` processes the result Then it raises a `SkillActivityError` for the missing sentinel rather than warning and falling back to the expected output path
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Treat missing sentinels as real failures
